hero.title: Preserving India's Heritage
hero.subtitle: Explore Our Collection
hero.description: Discover authentic Indian handicrafts, each one a unique piece of art, telling a story of tradition and skill.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Viraasat is a tribute to the soul of India's artisan communities. We provide a platform for talented craftspeople to share their ancestral skills and handmade treasures with the world. By purchasing from our artisans, you're helping preserve a legacy and empower a community.

about.title: Viraasat
about.description: Celebrating and empowering India's rich heritage of artisan communities.

connect.title: Stay Connected
connect.description: Receive updates on new arrivals and special offers.

footer.copyright: © 2024 Viraasat. All rights reserved. A tribute to handmade elegance.
